scope.paper_mechanism: A model-allocation portfolio trades private predictive risk against losses from correlated errors, with a cap on average predictive risk.
scope.miniature_comparison: Allocate 1,000 synthetic farms across nine error models using a constrained optimizer, uniform allocation, or the lowest estimated-risk model; score fresh simulated social loss. Approved admission scope: Compare model-consistent constrained optimization with monoculture in the declared synthetic Gaussian world, disclosing known correlation/loss parameters and noisy risk estimates. No empirical agriculture, welfare or true-risk-cap guarantee.
preserved_assumptions: Shared and idiosyncratic Gaussian errors with controllable cross-model correlation.

Fresh evaluation shocks are shared across methods.

unsupported_claims: Observed crop-yield improvements or monetary/ecological welfare.
